description: BrowserDefense Chrome Extension - Intune OMA-URI Configuration Template

metadata.description: Configure BrowserDefense Chrome extension via Intune custom policy

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - ExtensionSettings Policy
omaSettings.description: Master Chrome extension settings for BrowserDefense. This enables managed installation and configuration of the extension.

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Blocklist Endpoint
omaSettings.description: URL where the extension fetches signed blocklist updates

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Organization ID
omaSettings.description: Unique identifier for your organization included in forensics data

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Forensics Endpoint
omaSettings.description: URL where encrypted forensics data is uploaded (REQUIRED)

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - IOC Salt
omaSettings.description: Salt for IOC hashing - must match CLI compile salt (REQUIRED)

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Update Interval
omaSettings.description: How frequently to check for blocklist updates (in minutes)

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Signing Public Key
omaSettings.description: P-256 ECDSA public key in JWK format for verifying blocklist signatures (REQUIRED)

omaSettings.name: BrowserDefense - Encryption Public Key
omaSettings.description: RSA-OAEP public key in JWK format for encrypting forensics data (REQUIRED)

assignments.description: Assign to device groups containing managed Windows endpoints with Chrome installed

notes: Replace 'browserdefense_extension_id' with the actual Chrome Web Store extension ID
Replace placeholder values (YOUR_*, example.com) with your organization's values
Generate signing keys using: npx browserdefense-cli keygen --type signing
Generate encryption keys using: npx browserdefense-cli keygen --type encryption
Test with a pilot group before deploying organization-wide
